key_reasoning.reason: The fix adds a new pre_model_hook factory (_build_truncation_abort_pre_model_hook, plus a new _find_last_turn_ai_message helper) in supervisor/pre_model_hooks.py and wires it into both LangGraphAgent builder paths (_build_supervisor_agent and _build_single_agent). pre_model_hooks.py is a shared utility already composed via _compose_pre_model_hooks across multiple agent construction paths, so the change touches a core shared utility from two call sites rather than a single self-contained spot.

There is no exact existing precedent for aborting the tool-calling loop mid-turn on token-limit truncation; the hook reuses existing detection (_safe_check_for_truncation, _should_stop_streaming) but introduces new control-flow behavior in the production-critical agent streaming loop for both the supervisor's own node and arbitrary sub-agent nodes. Risk is tempered by thorough new test coverage (4 real-graph scenario tests plus 2 real-init wiring tests in test_langgraph_supervisor_truncation_stops_loop.py) but the behavioral change itself is novel enough to land at L rather than M/S.
